title: servers.channel_access_revoked
description: ChannelAccessRevoked is published when members who could see a channel (VIEW_CHANNELS after its per-role overrides) no longer can: an override or a role's permissions changed, a role was assigned, removed or deleted, the ownership was transferred, or the member was kicked, banned or left. There is one event per affected channel, text or voice; UserIDs holds only the members who lost access, never empty. Consumers cut what those users have open in the channel (a messaging socket, a voice room); gaining access is never published.

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

user_ids.description: Usuarios que perdieron el acceso a ese canal. Nunca vacío, sin repetidos.
